source: 8 registered original connected Google Drive exam PDF extracted-text documents; source slots and SHA from existing frozen 59 rows
normalization: strip first printed answer-parenthesis plus ordinal, normalize unicode NFKC, strip nonletter/nondigit chars to compare only. Split MC at first circled option index where present. copyright_scope: Original full stems, answer options, PDF or raster images are not copied into public checkpoint. Original source PDFs remain in connected Drive and original_sha lineage.
